summary: Website project for Skynet Services, a business offering CCTV and broadband services.
architectural_notes: Business name should be displayed as "Skynet Services" across the site (e.g., header/hero/footer/contact).

existing_features.title: Create a responsive multi-section marketing website (single-page layout is acceptable) for a business that offers CCTV installation and broadband services, with clear navigation and calls-to-action.

Add a Services section that clearly presents at least two service categories: CCTV (e.g., installation, maintenance, remote viewing setup) and Broadband (e.g., new connection, upgrades, troubleshooting). Use English for all user-facing text.
Add an About/Why Choose Us section suitable for a small local services business, including space for business name, service area, and key differentiators (e.g., fast installation, warranty, support).

Add a Contact section with a contact form that collects name, phone/email, service interest (CCTV/Broadband), and message, plus a visible block for business phone number and email address (as placeholders). Submission should provide an on-screen confirmation.

Establish a coherent visual theme appropriate for a security/telecom services business (avoid blue/purple by default), including typography, spacing, component styling, and consistent iconography across sections.
Add the required generated images as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated and use them in the UI (e.g., hero banner and logo) without routing images through the backend.

Update the business name to "Skynet Services" across all user-facing UI locations where the current business name appears (e.g., header brand text, footer brand text, About section heading, copyright line), and update relevant logo alt text accordingly.
Update the HTML document title to use the business name "Skynet Services" (replacing the current generic/old title).

new_feature_requests.summary: Create a business website for CCTV and broadband services.
